summary: Iteration 17 frontend E2E on preview URL. Verified all Tier-1 revenue UI flows: Navbar 'Work with SK' dropdown with 3 links (products/cohorts/corporate); Products page (products-grid, lead-magnet, non-blueprint CTA opens checkout-modal, Blueprint CTA correctly links to /assessment); Cohorts page (cohorts-grid, seats badge, Reserve-my-seat CTA opens checkout-modal); Case Studies page (3 case cards + testimonials-section, no 'AI' wording); Corporate inquiry form submits end-to-end and shows corporate-done; Lead-magnet submits and shows lead-magnet-done; Assessment 20 Big-Five questions -> submit -> LLM-generated result view -> blueprint-pro-upsell + blueprint-pro-buy opens checkout-modal; Admin login (consent+captcha) succeeds; Admin Revenue tab renders admin-revenue with all 5 sub-tabs; Products CMS create+edit+delete cycle works when 'Active' is ticked; Orders sub-tab renders summary cards + orders table. No 'AI' wording found on any tested public page. Razorpay checkout modal opens/closes cleanly and NO payment was completed. Overall 34/34 tested assertions pass. One notable UX bug in CMS admin listing (see frontend_issues).

ui_bugs.issue: CMS list is populated by fetching PUBLIC endpoints (/products, /cohorts, /case-studies, /testimonials) which filter by active/enabled=true. Newly created items with active=false are saved successfully (backend 200 + 'Saved.' toast) but never appear in the admin table, so admins cannot see, edit or delete their own draft/inactive items via the UI. Repro: Revenue -> Products -> New -> fill title/price, DO NOT tick 'Active', Save. Toast says 'Saved.' but no row is added. Fix: fetch from an admin listing endpoint (e.g. GET /api/admin/cms/{collection}) that returns ALL items regardless of active flag.

action_items: Change RevenueAdmin CollectionPanel.load() to hit an admin listing endpoint that includes inactive items, otherwise CMS-created inactive rows become 'ghost' items in the DB with no UI to manage them.

Consider defaulting the 'Active' checkbox to true in the New-item modal (or auto-set active=true on POST /admin/cms/{collection} when field is omitted) so admins do not accidentally create invisible items.
critical_code_review_comments: RevenueAdmin.jsx CollectionPanel.load() reuses PUBLIC endpoints for the admin table — leaks visibility rules into the admin surface and hides admin-created drafts. Recommend a dedicated admin listing endpoint per collection.
EditModal.save() does not send active:true by default; combined with the point above, this creates the 'silent create' UX bug reported.

AssessmentPage: LLM generation for the blueprint result can take 10-30s and the UI only shows 'Reading your profile...' with no progress indicator, timeout, or retry. Consider a hard timeout + fallback view.

Consent gate flow requires opening BOTH docs to enable the login checkbox — automation friendly (worked here) but painful on real UX; consider persisting the 'both opened' state in sessionStorage to avoid re-consent per tab reload.

rca of the issue: CMS 'ghost create' RCA: RevenueAdmin.CollectionPanel.load() (RevenueAdmin.jsx line 158-161) fetches from public catalogue endpoints (`/products`, `/cohorts`, `/case-studies`, `/testimonials`) which the backend filters by `active: true`. EditModal.save() (line 99-116) posts the form as-is; the 'active' bool defaults to falsy (undefined -> false after `!!payload[fl.key]` on line 104). Result: POST /api/admin/cms/products succeeds (returns 200, iter16 confirmed), the DB row is created with active=false, but the subsequent GET /api/products (public) filters it out. UI shows 'Saved.' toast but no row. Mitigation: (a) default active=true in EditModal initial state when item is new, OR (b) create GET /api/admin/cms/{collection} that ignores the active filter and switch load() to that endpoint (preferred — future-proof for drafts).
